blocking.title: A landing the player redirects abandons its own transports: the click walks to another port for weeks while its ships lie empty, splits into landings 21 days apart, or is refused 'no transports' (present on a54afc77 too)
blocking.evidence: Seed 3517, Japan, the two nearest Tokyo sent to Shanghai, both re-sent to Fuzhou 2 h after the first boards: groups 1136 and 1144 lie empty at Tokyo for the 54-day trace while 364 and 365 march to Sasebo (critic/c39_tied_two_fuzhou60.json); they land h1291 (critic/c39_ll_bothfar.json) against h657 from a standing start (critic/c39_base_fuzhou_2.json). Of three, two re-sent to Fuzhou by one click land h791 and h1293, the first alone (critic/c39_ll_three_twofar.json). The four, all re-clicked three cells SW where the R27b mark shows an orange landing, are all refused 18/6 'no transports' (critic/c39_ll_four_all_sw3.json; real click critic/c39_lwt5_four_allsw63.json, critic/shots/c39lwt5_four_allsw63_act.png). Same on run 38's commit a54afc77 (critic/c39_tied_two_fuzhou_a54.json, critic/c39_ll_three_twofar_a54.json, critic/c39_ll_four_all_sw3_a54.json). Cause read: orderMove/orderAshore pick transports for each division while its old ones are still that landing's; once all have left, the freed groups are never offered.
blocking.fix: When an order takes divisions off a landing, offer that landing's own transports first (or release them before choosing), so the click that leaves a landing takes its ships with it. AT: the two re-sent to Fuzhou 2 h after the first boards sail from Tokyo on their own groups and land within a day of each other by ~h700 (red: h1291); of three, the two sent to Fuzhou land within a day of each other; the four re-clicked three cells SW: no refusal, land together.
